title: dns-cli Preprod demo runtime state
description: Resumable demo progress stored at demo/runtime/state.json. Runners update confirmed steps atomically after each successful on-chain confirmation.

schemaVersion.description: State file schema version. Increment only with a coordinated runner migration.

mode.description: fresh = create wallets and submit Preprod txs; existing = read-only historical inspection.

network.description: Always Cardano Preprod for this demo.

provider.description: Chain data provider used for balance, submit, and status.

tld.description: TLD label used for proof generate and lifecycle commands (e.g. demo-20260714).

sld.description: SLD label minted under the TLD (default www).

confirmed.description: Per-step confirmation records. Empty txId means the step has not completed.

deploy.description: system init: publish three parameterized reference scripts.

txId.description: Confirmed transaction hash (64 hex), or empty string if not yet confirmed.

manifest.description: Relative or absolute path to the step's .manifest.json artifact, or empty string if not yet confirmed.
